description: No AI model involved: returns the structured data the page already publishes — JSON-LD / schema.org objects (products, articles, events, organisations, breadcrumbs), prices and offers, meta and Open Graph tags, canonical URL, language versions, licence, RSS/Atom/JSON feeds, and HTML data tables as columns + rows. Exact values instead of guesses from text. Charged only on success. Price: US$0.002 per successful call (API key credits or x402).
